rule: MTP step = the composed step (token_path_export) + every critical charge; overlapped charges carry their proof

charges.element: WFC kit (ot_rom_pkg_ctrl_wfc SOURCE/STG + dsfd_wfc_lnk + dsfd_wfc_vmx) on every stage hop
charges.formula: 120 stage hops (AR view critical path: substage/head hops + the unplaced stage hops) x 160.53 (WFC done->out + entry delta 13 + lnk 6 + vmx start 15 + vmx done/prefetch 79 + VM hub-station delta 29.03 + stage sequencer 18.5)
charges.variant: WFC HARD kit (STG CLOSED, HARD wfc_tok CLOSED, SOURCE partner routing); --wfc-hard is default-off on the die
charges.note: the composition charges the reference ot_rom_pkg_ctrl_wf (46/11,271 handoff, no shims) whose route was rejected; the real controller kit adds these on the verify AR pass. Same cycles on every AR token once the kit is default-on (ar_effect).

charges.element: WFC kit on the 5 wavefront intervals (positions 2-6)
charges.formula: 5 x (hop 160.53 + handoff 49 vs 46 on the busiest stage 8.6 + stage occupancy 141.53)
charges.note: upper bound charged: the vmx start/done cycles are counted both in the hop latency and as stage occupancy (no bench measures the handoff with vmx in place, so the overlap of the outbound prefetch with the next position's start is NOT proven); cycles_lower counts them once (845)

charges.element: dsfd_mtp_seq draft chain (seed rows -> first draft head, head result -> next head)
charges.note: bench means include the bench adapters (+2 in / +1 out): upper bound; each draft head step waits for the previous head's argmax (serial chain)

charges.element: dsfd_mtp_seq seed after the closing result + DRAFT flit / release
charges.formula: seed_after_close 8 + last_dh_to_draft_flit 14.4 (s0_hash_u1_fast: no squashed results to wait for)
charges.note: the other traces' release (51.6-231 cycles) includes waiting for squashed verify results the bench models serially; those positions are already charged as verify intervals

charges.element: dsfd_wfc_tok HARD (S0 token/draft store, one-edge read)

charges.formula: commit outputs registered 1 cycle after acc_done

charges.element: MD-2 P2 selected path (PRIMARY_SHARED1 9-SRAM transport + 3-SRAM A-prefix + publisher)
source: physical/mtp_p2_transport/route.sh header (codex/mtp-die-continuation 0091c7ad5 gate PASS 5,467 cycles; reproduced by mtp-lead for mtp-p2-path-{a,b}-91473d972-tc)
~/claude-takeover-20261007/REVIEW_20261009.md V22 (5,467 cycles per rank prefix, <= 6,240 model)
charges.variant: selected P2 path (routes queued, not closed); the composition's draft is the DP1-EP5 recovery placement
charges.note: per draft block the rank prefix replaces only the expert return hop; the block's combine all-reduce stays (no record replaces it): upper bound. Blocks are serial (block k+1 consumes block k's hc_post), so critical.

charges.element: P2 link ends (dsfd_p2_lnk + collective / VM ends, RTT-sized grant links)
charges.formula: 3 P2 transactions x (+9: tb_mtp_p2_fixlat NOSTALL 0 stations, link ends 6,122 vs core direct 6,113)
charges.note: the relay stations themselves are die wire stages (already the hop latency); this is the link-end pipeline only

charges.element: dedicated MTP lane adapter (dsfd_coll_mtp_lane): token return + seed traversals
charges.note: upper bound: both traversals charged serially; the collective's lanes 0..7 are untouched (coll_done equal)

charges.element: P2 dedicated lane adapters (dsfd_coll_p2_lane_pa / _ba): start in + last row out
charges.note: lane-1 words from die B arrive ahead of the start (buffered), off the chain

charges.formula: 5 draft steps x (first result 178 cycles - modelled 65.5)
charges.note: lower bound: the measured single-row pipeline latency is a floor the transfer-ratio model is under; the whole-vocab sweep throughput needs the head full340_A production wrapper (not built)

charges.element: draft-head step registers: ot_dsrom_markov_head_driver HBRELAY=1 + dsfd_vm_mtp_ep OUTPUT_PIPE 1
charges.formula: 5 draft-head steps x (+1 HBRELAY head-input relay + 1 vm_mtp_ep OUTPUT_PIPE)
charges.variant: HBRELAY=1 routes mtp-head340-mkdrv-hbr-{a,b}-d781e7cb0-tc (charged conservatively before adoption); vm_mtp_ep 189894fc2 route fixlat-vmmtp-189894fc2-tc-hm20

charges.element: routed experts on the bound MD-2 draft dies (rowpack whole-superrow layout)
charges.formula: (3375 - mtp.0 experts_gu 1429 + 1620 - down 1099) + (3375 - mtp.1 experts_gu 1429 + 1620 - down 1099) + (3375 - mtp.2 experts_gu 1429 + 1620 - down 1099); row = 3 experts x (GU 3 subphases x 375 + W2 2 x 270), all 3 on one die (upper bound; a split mtp.2 row runs A and B in parallel)
charges.note: the composition timed the experts on DP1-EP5 replicas (L0-pair images, one phase per expert group); the bound 40-die P2 home stores them in the rowpack, which needs up to 3 GU + 2 W2 subphases an expert

charges.element: MD-2 package-pair UCIe crossings (A -> B forward, B -> A expert return)
charges.formula: 4 crossings ({'mtp.0': 0, 'mtp.1': 2, 'mtp.2': 2}) x 17 (UCIe leg: leg1_first_flit -> first_flit, rec_x_row link RTL incl. the 11-cycle vendor channel)

charges.element: board hop P.k* -> head group (5 draft rows' hidden state to the LM-head sweep)
charges.formula: one 5-row stage hop = the measured mtp.0 hop_in 3470.0 cycles (same link, same payload)
charges.note: P2's primary-on-head-dies home made this hop die-local, but it has no room for the seed (669 > 631 pairs) and packs ~8x the words a pair a phase; the bound primary keeps L0's per-phase pair reads

charges.element: dsfd_mtp_seed_launch (descriptor receive / check, VM hidden-row fetch, x beats, program start)
charges.formula: desc_to_x 34 + done_to_ps 3 + (tau 4.159 - 1) x row_gap 35 (the committed rows of a step are seeded one after another; each extra row waits seed_ctl ready + the VM fetch)
charges.note: bench stations: descriptor 9/9, VM 6/6 + 12-cycle VM latency, x / join 4/4; the 240 beats and seed_ctl itself are the composition's seed term

charges.element: main-hidden row parts (L37/38/39 stage dies -> primary row store, one dedicated MTP lane a part)
charges.formula: per committed row and part: 1 header + 160 data flits on its own lane + 4 store cycles (write, complete)
charges.overlap_proof: a position's three parts leave the layer-37/38/39 stage dies when that position passes them in verify; they reach the primary after ONE board hop + 161 flits, while the same position's result still crosses every later stage to the head and the head -> primary seed lane before the seed descriptor can read the row; a late row only delays the read (pos_late), never changes the value

charges.element: collective command endpoint dsfd_coll_job (coll engine 3 under dsfd_stage_seq)
charges.formula: 210 coll ops on one pass of the stage programs x 1 (f_vm pin flop of the endpoint tile)
charges.note: upper bound (every coll op taken as critical); the same cycles apply to every AR pass (ar_effect)

sensitivity_not_credited.why_not_credited: dsfd_mtp_seq starts the draft at the closing result while positions a+1..5 are still in verify; the draft head steps then share the head die's lm_head bundle with the verify positions' head passes. The bench proves the sequencing, not a conflict-free head schedule: overlap NOT proven, so not credited

ar_effect.rule: the WFC kit's per-hop cycles on the AR pass + the collective command endpoint (+1 a coll op, 210); apply to the AR views when --wfc-hard is default-on
